When an issue isn't valid or won't be fixed in this PR, reply in its thread with the reason and then resolve the thread. If appropriate, use sub-agents to investigate and fix each issue separately. P2: Streaming still reports `end_turn` when the provider omits `finish_reason`. The surrounding `if (choice.finish_reason)` skips this call for absent or null values, and `closeStream` defaults to `end_turn`; derive the final reason from `state.toolCalls` when closing. ```
Reply with feedback, questions, or to request a fix.

P2: Streaming still reports `end_turn` when the provider omits `finish_reason`. The surrounding `if (choice.finish_reason)` skips this call for absent or null values, and `closeStream` defaults to `end_turn`; derive the final reason from `state.toolCalls` when closing.

<comment>Streaming still reports `end_turn` when the provider omits `finish_reason`. The surrounding `if (choice.finish_reason)` skips this call for absent or null values, and `closeStream` defaults to `end_turn`; derive the final reason from `state.toolCalls` when closing.</comment>

<file context>
@@ -641,7 +650,7 @@ function transformStreamChunk(chunk: string, state: StreamState): string | null
 
     if (choice.finish_reason) {
-      state.stopReason = toAnthropicStopReason(choice.finish_reason);
+      state.stopReason = toAnthropicStopReason(choice.finish_reason, state.toolCalls.size > 0);
       if (isRecord(data.usage) && !state.finalUsage) {
